hero.titleHtml: Klacksy: The AI assistant you simply tell your operating rules.
hero.subtitle: No generic off-the-shelf AI. Control the tone, autonomy and specialist vocabulary of a scheduling assistant that sticks exactly to your rules — rule-based, traceable, in your hands.
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacksy AI assistant in Klacks scheduling

items.title: Generic AI doesn't know your rules
items.text: Standard chatbots know nothing about your works agreements, qualification requirements or industry-specific regulations — every answer is a shot in the dark.

items.title: Unclear scope of action
items.text: With many AI tools, it is unclear what the AI may change on its own and what it may not — a risk as soon as real rosters are affected.

items.title: Foreign language, foreign abbreviations
items.text: A generic AI doesn't understand in-house abbreviations and technical terms — every request first has to be laboriously explained.

solutions.title: How Klacksy adapts to your business
solutions.subtitle: Five dials that turn Klacksy into your assistant.

items.title: Set the autonomy yourself
items.text: Four adjustable levels let you decide how much Klacksy may do on its own — from pure suggestions to independent changes. Sensitive actions always need your confirmation.

items.title: Operating rules, just by saying them
items.text: You simply describe a company rule in the chat — for example “night premium 25% from 11pm” or “maximum 3 night shifts per week”. Klacksy asks targeted questions until all required details are complete and checked, shows a preview of the result and saves only after your explicit confirmation — retrievable in the chat at any time, and reversible.

items.title: Store your own terms
items.text: In the dictionary, you store company-specific terms with their variants so that voice input recognises them correctly. Klacksy can also remember in-house abbreviations as a note.

items.title: Adjust the personality
items.text: With the personality editor, you set Klacksy's tone and character — to match your company culture.

example.title: A care service sets up Klacksy for its team
example.text: The autonomy level is set to “Propose”: Klacksy proposes every step first, and the planning engine checks the qualifications of the skilled staff — the final decision always stays with management. In addition, the night premium rule was set up just by saying it, and the abbreviations used in-house were recorded as a note for Klacksy. The assistant already responds accordingly today — without any programming.

cta.title: See Klacksy in action
cta.text: Try the Playground to see how Klacksy adopts autonomy levels, personality and specialist vocabulary — or install Klacks directly on your own infrastructure. No licence fees and no registration required.
